stem: (Select TWO.) Greymoor Analytics hit two real limits of the `lifecycle` block. Which two statements are correct?

choices.text: `prevent_destroy` does not stop Terraform from destroying a resource if its block is removed from the configuration entirely
`prevent_destroy` blocks a destroy plan under every circumstance, including when the resource's own block is deleted from the configuration
`create_before_destroy` can be set to a computed expression such as `var.replace_first`, the same way `count` can
Only literal values are allowed inside a `lifecycle` block; Terraform processes that block before it evaluates arbitrary expressions for the run
A `lifecycle` block can appear more than once inside the same resource block, with Terraform merging the settings from each copy

rationale: c is wrong and directly contradicts a; prevent_destroy has a documented gap where removing the resource's own configuration block bypasses it. d is wrong; lifecycle arguments only accept literal values, not a variable-derived expression, unlike count. e is wrong; a resource has a single lifecycle block, not several merged together.
